title: PixelNME - Pixel Art Enemies for RPG Maker

posts.author: VanillaBrocker
posts.body:
What is PixelNME?
PixelNME
is a series of pixel art enemy packs crafted specifically for RPG Maker MV/MZ, inspired by iconic video game (and pop culture in general) franchises. These assets are perfect for enhancing battles in your RPG projects, capturing the charm and nostalgia of classic games.
What is PixelChars?
PixelChars
is a series of pixel art character packs crafted specifically for RPG Maker MV/MZ. These assets are perfect for enhancing events, cutscenes, pre-battles, and mapping in your RPG projects.
What is the Cosplay Set?
The
Cosplay Sets
are free packs featuring characters that either don’t fit into my other collections or were created as practice. These include characters based directly on existing ones. You can use them as cameos or for any other purpose in your game. They’re completely free to use in both personal and commercial projects—no credit required.
You can download individual characters by expanding the "spoiler boxes" below, or get the full Cosplay Sets on
my Itch.io page
. I’ll keep this thread updated as new sets are released.
